## Appearance

Cedric possesses features of delicate refinement and large, dark blue eyes. Though small for his age in his youth, when he wore a halo of chestnut brown curls, he grew to become a tall, six-foot man with short-cut brown hair.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P21](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0021), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P11](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0011), [v3 ch.People P6](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0006), [v3 ch.Revelation P2](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0002), +1 more_

## Personality

Cedric Stanhope is an intelligent and exceptionally unusual child known for his brilliant mind and imaginative nature. Characterized by great manliness and a gentlemanly, cleanly demeanor, he maintains a desire to have a mother.

_Sources: [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P7](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0007), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P32](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0032), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P52](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0052), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P28](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0028), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P10](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0010), +1 more_

## History

After arriving from the States, Cedric Stanhope moved to [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) to reside near the beach with his grandmother. Upon attending school in [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley), he quickly formed an immediate, warm connection with his teacher, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), becoming her favorite student. A imaginative boy who detailed whimsical companions near the shore, he also shared conversations with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) about his late mother, his father, and his maid's comments when she visited him at his house. During a visit to [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage) with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), Cedric spent time with Miss Rosalind as she opened up to him about her imaginary dream-boy. Following the end of the school term, he met his unexpectedly returned father, [Stephen Stanhope](../character/stephen-stanhope.md), who went on to marry [Rosalind](../character/rosalind-penrose.md). Cedric remained close with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) over the years, attending her home before her wedding day and being fondly remembered by her as a talented writer who could turn adventurous life stories into books.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P0](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0000), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P11](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0011), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P20](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0020), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000), +40 more_

## Quotes

> "Mrs. Sowerby, father made a pretty good job of picking out my first mother and I could trust him to pick out just as good a one the second time."
>
> — Cedric Stanhope — [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P22](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0022)

> "you can’t imagine what took place! Something truly wonderful. Father has arrived . . . only imagine that! Father has arrived! Step right inside. Father, this is my lovely teacher. You understand, father."
>
> — Cedric Stanhope — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P21](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0021)

> "It is possible that you are well-known as well, Teacher. Over these past three years, I have come across much of what you have done."
>
> — Cedric Stanhope — [v4 CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG P35](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0035)

> "and I returned so I could offer them to you since I believed you were a lady who would appreciate them, and also because . . ."
>
> — Cedric Stanhope — [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P21](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0021)

> "Mary Joe, do you know what I think? I think the evening star is a lighthouse on the land where the fairies dwell."
>
> — Cedric Stanhope — [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P28](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0028)

## Relationships

### [Grandma Stanhope](../character/grandma-stanhope.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/cedric-stanhope--grandma-stanhope.md)

Cedric is the grandson of [Grandma Stanhope](../character/grandma-stanhope.md). He resides with her, discussing her and his late mother during walks and home visits with his teacher.

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/cedric-stanhope--nell-harcourt.md)

[Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Cedric share a strong mutual affection and understanding as teacher and pupil. Cedric frequently opens up to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) about his home life, late mother, and personal worries, while also walking with her through the village and visiting her at home. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) considers him a favorite student and offers him comfort and companionship.

### [Nora](../character/nora.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/cedric-stanhope--nora.md)

[Nora](../character/nora.md) is an imaginary rock person created by Cedric as a whimsical companion near the shore. He envisions participating in fantastic adventures alongside her and his other fantasy creations, such as sailing into the moon and traveling into the sunset.

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P41](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0041), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P43](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0043), +1 more_

### [Harcourt](../character/harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/cedric-stanhope--harcourt.md)

[Harcourt](../character/harcourt.md) served as Cedric's instructor in [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley). Cedric formed an immediate warm connection with her on her first day of school, gifting her wild orchids and writing affectionate letters detailing his imaginary adventures. They frequently spent time together walking to places like [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage) and preparing for community events.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P0](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0000), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P11](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0011), +14 more_
